name: Launch Video
tagline: A 20–40 second launch film from your screenshots: hook, problem, product, features, proof and date, in one of five styles.
youSay: /launch-video Orbit 2.0 launches on 1 December at orbit.app. Here are three screenshots; pick the style.
whatYouGet: A launch film in six scenes: a hook, the problem, your product revealed, up to four features, one proof number and the end card with the date
Five styles your agent picks from the product: clean, drafting (technical drawing), paper (cut paper, stop motion), pixel (8-bit) and bold (huge type on hard cuts)
Your real screenshots in a browser or phone, with slow zooms into the part that matters
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 from one story, plus the film as an editable HTML page
goodFit: Launching an app, a version or a feature
Product Hunt, landing pages, X and LinkedIn posts
notFor: Products you can't show screenshots of
Videos with footage, a presenter or voice-over
youBring: The product name, what it does, the date and URL
2–4 of your own screenshots, and a real number if you have one
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
